hardware: dual Intel Xeon X5690 3.47 GHz, RHEL 7.5, one socket isolated and tickless, network-latency tuned profile
workload: one symbol, 3 million messages: 9% GTC orders, 3% IOC, 6% cancels, 82% moves, about 1,000 resting orders over 750 price levels
measures: risk checks plus matching, open loop at a fixed offered rate, so queueing delay is included
